verdict.rationale: Otter's docs say key deal details, notes, and next steps are automatically extracted from every meeting and synced to your CRM. Salesforce and HubSpot integrations are listed on the pricing page, and a public API covers niche CRMs. Missing for 10: any documentation of how notes are matched to the right contact or deal records, native Attio support (only implied via the public API), an explanation of the asterisk caveat on the Salesforce/HubSpot integrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
